brand.name: Sigma Core Medical Center
brand.address: 725 Manakin Towne Lane, Manakin-Sabot, VA 23103 (reconfirm before launch)
brand.palette_guidance: Preserve the supplied deep navy, silver, and electric-blue identity. Translate the dimensional logo into flat accessible web roles: deep navy #101E33, electric blue #0877BE, silver #C7CBD0, warm mineral #F7F6F3, charcoal #20272E, and restrained walnut #9A572B sampled from the real clinic. Metallic effects belong only to the supplied logo and fine structural keylines. No purple gradients, sterile hospital blue, or invented bright hues.
brand.voice: Direct-response, concise, premium, calm, and patient-centered. Benefit-led without hype, jargon, fear, or unsupported medical claims.
brand.identity_belief: A longer, more active life starts with a clear, personalized next step focused on movement, function, recovery, and independence.
brand.visual_metaphor: The core mark becomes a precise field of concentric arcs and one measured horizon line: an organizing system for progress, not a medical diagram.
brand.asset_note: The supplied reception and waiting-room photographs are authoritative Sigma Core location imagery. Preserve the real built environment and logo. Never regenerate the facility, redesign the wordmark, or imply a generic person is a Sigma Core provider or patient.

hard_rules: Use the supplied Sigma Core logo and wordmark as-is. Never redesign, recolor, re-letter, regenerate, restyle, or reinterpret it; design references use plain type or a neutral reserved logo area.
Richmond, Virginia is the only market. Exclude Fort Lauderdale and every Florida reference.
Never claim Sigma Core cures or reverses any disease or condition, guarantees outcomes, restores youth, eliminates pain, avoids surgery, or provides a named treatment that has not been verified.

Keep service information concise, benefit-led, non-diagnostic, and at category level. Do not publish treatment protocols, mechanisms, prices, candidacy, timelines, medications, tests, devices, or unverified modalities.
Do not identify Dr. Jason Hurst as a treating provider or show him in a public clinical team structure.

Do not invent Medical Director or Nurse Practitioner names, photos, biographies, credentials, testimonials, ratings, awards, certifications, badges, statistics, patient outcomes, insurance details, appointment duration, availability, phone, email, or hours.

Do not render empty provider cards, fake team portraits, fake testimonial cards, star ratings, before-and-after imagery, or unsupported trust signals. Team and testimonial components may be modular in code but remain absent publicly until approved real content exists. Any future testimonial must visibly state 'Results not typical'.
Stock or AI-generated clinicians must never be shown as Sigma Core staff. Generic people must never be labeled as patients, providers, named individuals, or result examples.

Use supplied reception and waiting-room photos as the only authoritative facility imagery. Preserve their actual architecture, logo, and materiality; never fabricate a different Sigma Core clinic. Generated editorial lifestyle photography may show anonymous, fully clothed adults walking, stretching, gardening, or living actively in clearly non-clinical settings, but never as Sigma Core patients, staff, testimonials, before-and-after subjects, or evidence of results.

Direction A must be photovisual and medically credible. No 3D-rendered environments, abstract caves, portals, sculptural rooms, metallic ribbons, liquid chrome, glowing energy streams, fantasy architecture, product-render slabs, material mazes, or text embedded on rendered objects. Use photographic image fields, clean flat editorial layouts, restrained crop masks, and simple code-native lines or blocks.
General marketing forms collect no free-text medical history, symptoms, diagnosis, or other PHI. Any PHI workflow requires an appropriate HIPAA agreement and safeguards.
Do not load standard advertising or analytics trackers on authenticated or condition-specific patient flows without compliance review.
The educational guide must not appear available until the customer supplies the approved resource title, media, delivery method, consent language, and GoHighLevel details.
The address 725 Manakin Towne Lane, Manakin-Sabot, VA 23103 and the September 8, 2026 opening date must be reconfirmed before launch and any time-sensitive opening treatment removed once stale.

No generic hospital-blue template, sterile all-white system, purple-to-blue SaaS gradient, glassmorphism, decorative medical dashboard, DNA helix, molecule, lotus, glowing nerve, anatomical fear image, autoplay video, intrusive popup, fake scarcity, or tiny low-contrast silver copy.

Do not use visible 01/02/03 sequence numbers, chapter numbers, folio numbers, oversized ghost numerals, or numbered editorial markers. Communicate sequence with language, spatial progression, material transitions, or unnumbered wayfinding.
Primary body copy is at least 18px in the coded site, controls are at least 48px, contrast is WCAG AA or better, and reduced-motion preferences are honored.
Every visually control-shaped element has the useful outcome defined in its section interaction_contract. State labels, steps, and principles are static content, not inert controls.
Direction A and Direction B are two complete creative territories. Direction B is generated in a fresh session from its own fingerprint and must not be a recolor or reference-edit of A.
successor_scoped_overrides: Current user request and these scoped overrides take precedence over incompatible historic brand, blueprint, hard_rules and asks. Inherited address/opening-target and facility assets are archival provenance only, NEVER visible copy or runtime assets for this candidate.
All four preserved Contact IDs remain. Render only required_sections exact content; no inherited address, opening date, phone, email, hours value, invented map pin, facility, calendar or form.

Extend selected Direction B The Forward Standard, using Source Sans 3 700/800 headings and selective Playfair Display 500 counterpoint. The inherited home typography prose is older serif-led material; selected B native frames and the independently reviewed Book successor establish this role hierarchy.
Zero photographs, zero raster build assets. Do not screenshot source as reference. Authentic Home image is linked explicitly, never duplicated or generated.

Do not imply current verification activity, verified visit availability, contact availability, opening, scheduling availability, future timing, notification, clinical approval or legal/security assurances.

All statuses remain CANDIDATE_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW; producer self-check is not an independent judgment. No implementation, QA, source fidelity, Site Review, clinical/legal, customer or promotion approval.
Frames contain content sections only, never global navigation or footer. No section numbers / no folio numerals anywhere in the frame.
Use action #0666A5 for the blue reading field. Electric #0877BE is decoration. Exact loadable fonts and flat palette tokens win over image-model glyph and color drift.

Real booking, public contact readiness and legal content remain unavailable or unconfirmed. /book and legal noindex, follow gates remain. Navigation conveys information only; no data collection or alternate booking channel.

Location details static truthful readiness info, facility section zero-photo visit-status + meaningful link to existing authentic Home image if useful and explicit, closing section useful Services/About/status navigation not fake booking.

Use zero-photo compositions matching selected Forward Standard B palette/type/geometry; current address/phone/hours/scheduling facts unknown, honestly state only supported pending information, no fake map/form/calendar/phone/address or clinical/legal assurances.
Exactly source-backed copy and useful observable anchor outcomes; distinct composition hierarchy and quiet/loud rhythm, not repeated generic cards.

approved_world.name: The Forward Standard (selected Direction B)
approved_world.brand_world_paragraph: Sigma Core's selected Forward Standard world uses flat deep-navy anchors #101E33, accessible action-blue #0666A5 fields, electric-blue #0877BE geometric accents, warm-mineral #F7F6F3 breathing space, charcoal #20272E closure, and restrained silver #C7CBD0 keylines. Source Sans 3 is the strong, open-countered performance voice for headlines, body and actions; Playfair Display appears only as a selective small human counterpoint. The motif is precise squared brackets, angular fields and stepped signal bars with dramatic changes of scale. This Contact successor uses no photographs, textures, people, clinic rooms, medical symbols, logo redraws or illustration. Its character comes from typography, asymmetry and simple responsive geometry, never a dashboard, framed slide, generic centered card stack, glass, gradient or 3D object.

typography.headline: Source Sans 3 700/800
typography.counterpoint: Playfair Display 500; only Clinic photo label

ink.role: Primary authority field, inverse sections, and strongest text
ink.rationale: Matches the real reception feature wall and the supplied logo's deep navy foundation.

surface.role: Primary reading surface and quiet sections
surface.rationale: Drawn from the warm-neutral facility walls, it avoids a sterile all-white medical template.

action.role: Primary actions, selected states, and accessible links
action.rationale: A darkened electric blue from the logo preserves the brand while giving white CTA text accessible contrast.

electric.role: Motif, registration marks, image framing, and non-text emphasis
electric.rationale: This is the vivid blue center of the real core mark and should remain an energetic accent rather than a large body-copy field.

silver.role: Fine keylines, quiet dividers, and light structural surfaces
silver.rationale: Carries the brushed-silver logo and wall-sign materiality as restrained structure instead of metallic UI effects.

charcoal.role: Secondary dark field and dark body copy
charcoal.rationale: Echoes the reception desk and seating, giving facility photography a grounded companion surface.

walnut.role: Restrained warm material accent tied to the actual clinic interior
walnut.rationale: The real wood desk and slats humanize the navy-silver system; this color is for small material moments, never primary conversion.

muted.role: Secondary body and helper copy on mineral surfaces
muted.rationale: Maintains readable hierarchy for an older audience without low-contrast silver copy.

light.role: Inverse text and controls on navy, charcoal, and action fields
light.rationale: Provides maximum clarity for key headings and actions.

hover.role: Primary action hover and active navigation
hover.rationale: A darker logo-blue response is obvious without introducing a new color family.

focus.rationale: The pale highlight from the dimensional logo remains visible on both dark and light contexts.

approved_world.proof_limit: Existing approved-world proofs are inherited; no new typography/palette selection or new live responsive proof is claimed.

source_backing.basis: Clinic name/sole Richmond area and pending public operational facts. Authored title and labels introduce no new fact; pending avoids unsupported active-verification inference.

Online booking unavailable; Services, About and scheduling status are information-only destinations. Navigation labels and descriptions accurately summarize observable existing sections.
